title: 第15章 愉悦的往事第16章 又见师娘
content_zh:
方多病临行之前邀请海女小芳一家前来做客，说了离别之事。在这里住的这许多日子也靠着小芳一家时时观照，村中之人才无人有太多异议。
他们还没开口说离开，小芳一家却抢先说自己家将要搬家。原来到东海比武的江湖客越来越多，村里不堪其扰，准备整个村子迁往别处。
李莲花一听这是李相夷与笛飞声之故，心中愧疚，定要帮村中之人解决这个难题。
方多病却说这事不值一提，当即给笛飞声送信，让笛飞声想办法在此处建立分坛，并将无颜留在村中，保护村民安危直到分坛成立。
李莲花和方多病挤着坐在一起，赶着马车，本来方多病害怕李莲花身体还未痊愈，怕他吃不消，让他进车厢中休息，可李莲花说车厢里太过憋闷，还是一起赶车畅快一些。
这马车确实是现买的，别说比不上莲花楼了，就是连方多病平时用的马车也比不上，但是小渔村实在偏远，根本买不到好的马车，方多病就心想着等到了大的城市再换好的也不迟，车厢确实憋闷，两人一起赶车，还能聊聊天，一起说说话，就同意与李莲花坐在一处，只留狐狸精在车厢里，他两一处聊天解闷。
马车的速度并不快，李莲花的身体也没有恢复，不如慢慢前行，这马车便晃晃悠悠的朝着云隐山行进。
“笛盟主，”李莲花慢悠悠的开口，不疾不徐的和方多病聊着天，“你和笛盟主关系很好吗？”
“算是吧！”方多病专心驾车，听着这慢悠悠的口气，一瞬间好像回到了驾着莲花楼一同闯荡江湖的那些日子。
“你们怎么，”李莲花觑了一眼坐在身边的少年，好像是不经意的聊着天，“是怎么认识的？”
“就是在莲花楼认识的呀！”方多病有些好奇了，这些日子李莲花都没有对他们三个人之间的关系产生过好奇，今天是怎么了，“不对，应该更早一点儿，是咱们去一品坟的时候，我第一次见到的阿飞。”
“一品坟？！”李莲花琢磨着这个地方，好像有点儿耳熟。
“也算是不打不相识吧，抢夺观音垂泪的时候，还打过一场架。”他又想起一品坟按道理来说应该是李莲花的祖坟，没想到他带着一群人把自家祖坟挖了，想着不觉笑出了声。“你当时说你有心疾，骗我说你要那观音垂泪，结果却是为了引出笛飞声。”
“你笑什么呐？”李莲花看着少年人的笑脸，好奇什么事情让他这么开心，他倒是不太在乎自己骗人这件事。
“当时，阿飞用了缩骨功，变成了一个小孩，我还一直怕他被别人打死。”方多病想起自己那时和李莲花的对话越想越开心，耐心解释其中原委，“结果他先把别人打死了。”
“阿飞一直都是这样的，能动手绝不废话！”李莲花想起李相夷和笛飞声的交往，笛盟主确实不爱解释，动起手来也不心软。
“你知道吧！”方多病忽的看了李莲花一眼，想起那个红衣魔女，“你和角丽谯是有些血缘关系的。”
李莲花想起自己曾经听这少年讲过，是讲单孤刀想称帝就是以为自己是南胤后裔，结果闹了乌龙，自己才是正经的南胤后裔皇家血脉，于是点了点头。
“那一品坟就是你祖奶奶的坟茔。”
“哈哈哈……”李莲花自己也笑出了声，真是大水冲了龙王庙了，也是命该如此。

“那后来呐？”李莲花止住了笑声，江湖儿女谁还讲究什么出身，本来自己也就是个无父无母的小乞丐，还是方多病的事情比较重要，“后来咱们就一起闯荡江湖？”
“没有，我和阿飞总是争来争去的，差点拆了你的莲花楼，你被气得不轻！天天用脸骂我们！”方多病想起那时李莲花生气的样子，也觉得十分好笑，他从来没见过人能用脸骂出那么脏的脏话。
又看了看李莲花的脸，心中有些遗憾，好久没在老狐狸脸上看见那些生动的表情了，李相夷还是李相夷，总是一本正经的样子，不过也很可爱。
李莲花被身边的少年看红了脸，也思忖着，自己这十年到底经历了什么，听这少年的描述，怎么会活的像一只狐狸？
居然还学会用脸骂人吗？那倒是挺有意思。
也许只有找回这些记忆自己才能真正的重生！李相夷的那些不愉快的往事也能随烟消散！
他安静的听着旁边的少年继续说着往事，并没有打断少年的话，又下意识的去看身旁驾车人的脸，这脸白中带粉，又有一丝张扬，倒是让人心跳加速……
不对，不对，李莲花赶紧移开视线，怎么会心跳加速，赶紧平复心情，继续听方多病说下去。
“那时阿飞被你封了穴脉，使不了武功，可是我的手下败将呐！”赶车的少年得意的说，他完全忘了后来被笛飞声打到吐血这件事儿了。
“我看你和笛飞声的感情很好嘛？”李莲花闭上眼睛，只闲闲地说，“金鸳盟的人都随你调遣了。”
“那也是因为你呀！”方多病皱了一下眉头，立刻又语气轻快起来，“我们有共同的目标，就是找到你，治好你，让你长命百岁呀！”
李莲花点了点头，没有搭话，心里只想着自己怎么给别人添了这么多麻烦，可想到自己如今的情况，只得苦笑一下。
“只是我们找到你以后的目标不一样。”少年又开口说道，“我想和你一起结伴，闯荡江湖，而阿飞只是想痛痛快快的和你打一架！”
“不过现在好了，我们找到了你，也治好了你，再没什么碧茶毒发了。”方多病这次是真的放下心来，以前的李莲花总是骗他自己没事儿，这次是药魔盖章认定的碧茶已解，那就是真的没事了。
“我现在可打不了架咯！”李莲花大体知道了前因后果，这才笑着应道，“倒是能陪你闯荡闯荡江湖，不过还是需要少侠你的保护才行，毕竟现在的我肩不能扛手不能提，多走两步就要气喘吁吁。”
“你可是哪里觉得不舒服？”方多病听身旁的人这样说，又怕他坐车时间太长有哪里不舒服，“可要停下来歇歇脚？”
“那就停下来歇歇吧！”
“你怎么样了？”方多病一边勒紧缰绳，让马车慢慢停稳一边赶紧问他，还不放心的要去抚上他的心口。
“没有，我很好，”李莲花笑看着方多病的动作，也不阻止他手上的动作，下意识伸手去捏他的脸颊，莫得手上一顿，只好开口缓解这有些尴尬的气氛，“只是车厢里的狐狸精，我怕它在车厢里时间太久憋坏了。”
方多病有些愣怔，以前李莲花也这样捏过自己的脸，只是他怎么又收回了手，只好轻咳一声，将马车停稳，呼唤狐狸精下车活动，拿出一个水囊递给李莲花，看着他喝了几口水，才听他说。

“等这次回云隐山看完师娘，咱们再去以前一起去过的地方走走吧！”李莲花喝了水，恢复了那懒洋洋的口吻，说出了方多病此时心中的期盼，“我想知道咱们一起走过的日子。”
方多病忽觉拨云见日，这些天的努力没有白费，李莲花终于想知道那些和自己一起度过的时光了，那是他十九年中学到东西最多的一段时间，也是自己十九年生命中最快乐的一段光阴。
“好！”少年愉悦的声音响起，他起身去追狐狸精，边跑边喊，“狐狸精，狐狸精，你快一点儿，咱们还要赶路呢！”
归心似箭，云隐山仿佛就在眼前，李莲花，你不要走的太远，我要与你追回咱们共同的记忆。
content_en:
Before leaving, Fang Duobing invited Xiaofang, the Hainv, and his family to come and talk about his farewell. During the many days I lived here, I relied on Xiaofang's family to watch over me all the time, and no one in the village had any objections.
Before they could say anything about leaving, Xiaofang's family was the first to say that their family was going to move. It turns out that more and more Jianghu people came to the East China Sea to compete, and the village could not bear the disturbance and prepared to move the entire village elsewhere.
When Li Lianhua heard that this was the fault of Li Xiangyi and Di Feisheng, she felt guilty and decided to help the people in the village solve this problem.
However, Fang Duobing said that this matter was not worth mentioning, and immediately sent a letter to Di Feisheng, asking Di Feisheng to find a way to establish a branch here, and to keep Wuyan in the village to protect the safety of the villagers until the branch was established.
Li Lianhua and Fang Duobing sat crowded together and drove the carriage. Originally, Fang Duobing was afraid that Li Lianhua had not recovered yet and that he would not be able to bear it, so he asked him to rest in the carriage. However, Li Lianhua said that the carriage was too depressing, so it would be more relaxing to drive together.
This carriage was indeed bought now, not to mention not as good as the Lotus House, even the carriage that Fang Duobing usually used. However, the small fishing village was really remote and it was impossible to buy a good carriage. Fang Duobing thought that it would not be too late to get a better one when he got to a big city. The carriage was really boring. The two drove together and could chat and talk together, so they agreed to sit together with Li Lianhua, leaving the vixen alone in the carriage. He chatted to relieve his boredom.
The carriage was not moving very fast, and Li Lianhua's body had not recovered. It was better to move forward slowly, and the carriage swayed towards Yunyin Mountain.
"Leader Di," Li Lianhua said slowly, chatting with Fang Duobing leisurely, "Do you have a good relationship with Leader Di?"
"That's right!" Fang Duobing concentrated on driving. Listening to this slow tone, he seemed to have returned to the days when he drove the Lotus Tower and traveled around the world together.
"How do you guys," Li Lianhua glanced at the young man sitting next to him, seeming to be chatting casually, "how do you know each other?"
"We met at Lianhua Building!" Fang Duobing was a little curious. Li Lianhua had never been curious about the relationship between the three of them these days. What happened today, "No, it should have been earlier. It was A Fei who I met for the first time when we went to Yipin Cemetery."
"First Grade Grave?!" Li Lianhua thought about this place and it seemed a bit familiar.
"It's like we don't know each other without fighting. When we robbed Guanyin and shed tears, we even had a fight." He also remembered that the Yipin Tomb should logically be Li Lianhua's ancestral tomb. Unexpectedly, he led a group of people to dig his own ancestral tomb, and he laughed out loud thinking about it. "You said at the time that you had a heart problem and lied to me that you wanted Guanyin to cry, but in the end it was just to induce the sound of the flute flying."
"Why are you laughing?" Li Lianhua looked at the young man's smiling face and wondered what made him so happy. He didn't really care that he was lying to others.
"At that time, Ah Fei used the bone-shrinking technique and turned into a child. I was always afraid that he would be beaten to death by others." Fang Duobing became more and more happy when he thought about his conversation with Li Lianhua at that time, and patiently explained the whole story, "In the end, he beat others to death first."
"A Fei has always been like this, he can take action and never talk nonsense!" Li Lianhua thought of the interaction between Li Xiangyi and Di Feisheng. Leader Di really didn't like to explain, and he was not soft-hearted when he took action.
"You know!" Fang Duobing glanced at Li Lianhua suddenly, remembering the witch in red, "You and Jiao Liqiao are somewhat related by blood."
Li Lianhua remembered that she had heard this young man say that Shan Gudao wanted to be emperor because he thought he was a descendant of Nanyin, but he made a mistake. He was the legitimate royal descendant of Nanyin, so he nodded.
"That first-grade tomb is your grandma's tomb."
"Hahaha..." Li Lianhua herself laughed out loud. The flood really washed away the Dragon King Temple, and it was destined to be like this.
"Then later? "Li Lianhua stopped laughing. No one in the world cares about their origins. She was just a little beggar without a father and mother. Fang Duobing's matter was more important. "Then we will travel together in the world? "
"No, A Fei and I always argue and almost demolished your Lotus Building. You were so angry! He scolds us with his face every day! "Fang Duobing thought of Li Lianhua's angry look at that time and found it very funny. He had never seen anyone swearing such dirty words with their face.
Looking at Li Lianhua's face again, I felt a little regretful. It had been a long time since I saw those vivid expressions on the old fox's face. Li Xiangyi was still Li Xiangyi, always serious, but also very cute.
Li Lianhua blushed at the sight of the young man next to her, and thought about what she had experienced in the past ten years. Listening to this young man's description, how could she live like a fox?
Did you actually learn to curse with your face? That's quite interesting.
Maybe only by retrieving these memories can I truly be reborn! Li Xiangyi's unpleasant past can also disappear with smoke!
He quietly listened to the young man next to him continue to talk about the past, without interrupting the young man's words, and subconsciously looked at the face of the driver next to him. This face was white with pink, and a little arrogant, which made people's hearts beat faster...
No, no, Li Lianhua quickly looked away. Why was her heart beating so fast? She quickly calmed down and continued to listen to Fang Duobing.
"At that time, Ah Fei had his acupuncture points sealed by you and couldn't use martial arts, but my men were defeated! "The young man driving the car said proudly. He had completely forgotten about being beaten by Di Feisheng until he vomited blood.
"I think you and Di Feisheng have a good relationship? "Li Lianhua closed her eyes and said casually, "The people of the Golden Yuan League are at your disposal. "
"That's also because of you! Fang Duobing frowned, and immediately spoke briskly again, "We have the same goal, which is to find you, cure you, and make you live a long life!" "
Li Lianhua nodded and said nothing. She only thought about why she had caused so much trouble to others. But thinking of her current situation, she could only smile bitterly.
“It’s just that our goals after finding you are different. The young man said again, "I want to be with you and travel in the world, but A Fei just wants to have a good fight with you!" "
"But it's okay now. We found you and cured you. There is no more Bicha poison. "Fang Duobing is really relieved this time. In the past, Li Lianhua always lied to him that he was fine. This time, the medicine demon stamped his seal and confirmed that Bicha has been cured, which means everything is really fine.
"I can't fight now! Li Lianhua generally understood the cause and effect, and then responded with a smile, "I can accompany you to travel in the world, but I still need your protection, young hero. After all, I can't carry it on my shoulders or lift it, and I will be out of breath if I take more than two steps." "
"Where do you feel uncomfortable? "Fang Duobing heard what the people next to him said, but he was afraid that he would feel uncomfortable if he sat in the car for too long, "Do you want to stop and take a rest? "
“Then stop and take a rest! "
"How are you? "Fang Duobing asked him quickly while tightening the reins and letting the carriage stop slowly. He felt uneasy and wanted to touch his heart.
"No, I'm fine." Li Lianhua looked at Fang Duobing's movements with a smile, and did not stop the movement of his hands. She subconsciously reached out to pinch his cheeks. She had no choice but to speak to ease the awkward atmosphere, "It's just a vixen in the carriage. I'm afraid it will be suffocated after being in the carriage for too long. "
Fang Duobing was a little stunned. Li Lianhua had pinched his face like this before, but why did he retract his hand again? He coughed slightly, stopped the carriage, called the vixen to get out of the car and move about, took out a water bag and handed it to Li Lianhua, watching him drink a few water before listening to what he said.
"When we return to Yunyin Mountain to see Master Niang this time, we canLet’s go to places we’ve been together before! "Li Lianhua drank the water, resumed her lazy tone, and expressed Fang Duobing's expectation at this time, "I want to know the days we have spent together. "
Fang Duobing suddenly woke up and saw the sun. These days' efforts were not in vain. Li Lianhua finally wanted to know about the time he spent with him. It was the time when he learned the most in his nineteen years, and it was also the happiest time in his nineteen years of life.
"Okay! "The boy's joyful voice sounded. He got up and chased the vixen, shouting as he ran, "Fox, vixen, hurry up, we have to hurry! "
Homecoming is like an arrow, Yunyin Mountain seems to be right in front of you, Li Lianhua, don't go too far, I want to recover our common memories with you.
